## README

# 🦜️🔗 LangChain.js

npm License: MIT Twitter

LangChain is a framework for building LLM-powered applications. It helps you chain together interoperable components and third-party integrations to simplify AI application development — all while future-proofing decisions as the underlying technology evolves.

**Documentation**: To learn more about LangChain, check out the docs.

If you're looking for more advanced customization or agent orchestration, check out LangGraph.js. our framework for building agents and controllable workflows.

> [!NOTE]
> Looking for the Python version? Check out LangChain.

To help you ship LangChain apps to production faster, check out LangSmith.
LangSmith is a unified developer platform for building, testing, and monitoring LLM applications.

## ⚡️ Quick Install

You can use npm, pnpm, or yarn to install LangChain.js

```sh
npm install -S langchain
# or
pnpm install langchain
# or
yarn add langchain
```

## 🚀 Why use LangChain?

LangChain helps developers build applications powered by LLMs through a standard interface for agents, models, embeddings, vector stores, and more.

Use LangChain for:

- **Real-time data augmentation**. Easily connect LLMs to diverse data sources and external/internal systems, drawing from LangChain’s vast library of integrations with model providers, tools, vector stores, retrievers, and more.
- **Model interoperability**. Swap models in and out as your engineering team experiments to find the best

# Anthropic's AI Update Brings Smarter, Faster Conversations

 LangChain Releases October 13, 2026 

⚡ Your AI chats just got better at remembering context and switching topics.

Deep Dive

The langchain-anthropic Python package has moved from version 1.7.5 to 1.7.6. The changelog shows the 1.7.6 release, a refresh of model profile data, and a change declaring mid-conversation support in model profiles across core, anthropic, and openai. It also bumps dependencies: langgraph-sdk from 0.4.4 to 0.4.6 and from 0.4.2 to 0.4.4, and urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0.

Key Points

- Anthropic's Claude AI can now remember more of your conversation and handle topic changes better.
- The update also fixes behind-the-scenes issues to make AI apps more stable and secure.
- You'll experience fewer frustrating moments where the AI forgets what you just said.

### Why It Matters

Better AI memory means less repetition and more natural, helpful conversations in your daily tasks.
